messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team — heads up I'm out sick Sat+Sun (flu). Can someone pick up the overnight window (Sat 22:00-06:00 UTC) and the Sunday evening oncall block? I can swap the Sat daytime if that helps. Leaving quick handoff notes below.

Alex Kim: I can take Sat overnight (22:00-06:00). Will be on phone + laptop, ping me for quick context.

Prateek Singh: I can cover Sunday evening (18:00-02:00). Will shadow first 30m for context.

Maya Patel: Thanks 🙏. Quick notes: no active incidents. FRIDAY night model rollout may leave a warmup job on some GPUs — watch for sustained high GPU mem usage and 'gwarm' processes. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall (see section 'warmup & canary'). Prewarm command (use ops token):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/ops/prewarm -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-q4", "region":"us-west-2"}'
```
If latency > 250ms 95p for >5m, trigger scale-to-dedicated: Console > Dedicated > Pools > select 'inference-usw2' > Scale (increase nodes by 1). Prefetch log path on host: /var/logs/prefetch.log — grep for "OOMcache" or repeated "prefetch fail".

Hugo Lopez: FYI we have a canary deploy window Sat 23:30-00:30 UTC. Whoever is on the Sat overnight, please be available for the canary check (watch traces and error rate).

Alex Kim: noted, I'll be around for canary. I'll also run a quick warmup 10m before the window.

Priya Rao: I'll be on standby as overflow for paging. If any noisy alerts come, tag me and I'll handle first triage.

oncall-bot: Rotation updated — Alex Kim assigned 2026-03-21T22:00Z to 2026-03-22T06:00Z; Prateek Singh assigned 2026-03-22T18:00Z to 2026-03-23T02:00Z.

Maya Patel: Appreciate it all. I'm leaving SSH jumpbox creds and a short checklist in the handoff doc (https://redwood.internal/docs/handoffs/maya-2026-03-21). Key checks: 1) confirm prewarm completes, 2) check model latency dashboard, 3) run quick sample through /v1/generate to verify KV cache behavior. If something blocks, escalate to @eng-sre.

Alex Kim: 👍 I'll post a 15-min-before-shift readiness update and again at canary start.

Prateek Singh: added a quick note to the handoff doc about session tokens and where to revoke them if needed.

Maya Patel: Thank you everyone. I'll try to check DMs but resting — send :rotating_light: if urgent and tag @eng-oncall.
